testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle the lock marker on a copied view representation: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:923:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle the lock marker on a copied view representation ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Primary is the active view representation ✔ And an unlocked copied view representation exists in the expanded View branch ✔ When the user opens the copied view representation's context menu ✔ Then Lock is unchecked ✔ And Publish is checked ✔ And activates and Copy are available ✔ And Edit View is unavailable ✔ When the user chooses Lock ✔ Then a lock symbol appears beside the copied view representation ✔ And Primary remains active ✔ When the user reopens the copied view representation's context menu ✔ Then Lock is checked ✔ When the user chooses Lock again ✔ Then the lock symbol disappears from the copied view representation ✔ When the user reopens its context menu ✔ Then Lock is unchecked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the context menu closes
